primary_sources.citation: Livshyts--Paouris--Pivovarov, On sharp bounds for marginal densities of product measures, arXiv:1507.07949
primary_sources.use: For a cap-one product density, every k-dimensional orthogonal marginal has density cap 2^(k/2); k=1 is used on each disjoint scalar bank.

primary_sources.use: Scope check only; not applicable to arbitrary non-iid rough cap-one inputs because its quadratic-form regularity framework assumes iid inputs with a sufficiently smooth Gaussian-field representation and further conditions.
